descriptions.value: In multiple functions of XmpDataParser.java, there is a possible improper data sanitization due to a logic error in the code. This could lead to local information disclosure with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

A heap overflow in the a2dp_decoder_sbc.cpp component of Bestechnic Co., Ltd BES2300 Bluetooth Audio SoC firmware v3.x and earlier allows attackers to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) via sending a crafted L2CAP packet.

Information leak in Mobile in Google Chrome on on iOS prior to 153.0.8010.36 allowed a remote attacker leveraging social engineering to leak sensitive information via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Low)

Improper certificate validation in FedCM in Google Chrome prior to 153.0.8010.36 allowed a remote attacker leveraging social engineering to bypass web origin policy via crafted network traffic. (Chromium security severity: Low)

title: Nodemailer: Quadratic (O(n²)) time complexity in addressparser allows remote denial of service via a crafted address list
Apache Camel-IRC: The irc.sendTo (and other irc.*) Exchange header constants used non-Camel-prefixed names that bypass the HTTP header filter
Duplicate Advisory: FileSystemPathPointer.open() sandbox check is dead code — arbitrary file read via file:// protocol
Smarty: SSRF via redirect bypass of trusted_uri using {fetch}
gettext-converter: Prototype pollution in js2i18next() via crafted translation keys
ep_etherpad-lite: Device-to-device author-token transfer endpoint is replayable, never expires, and exposes the cleartext author token

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Adobe Reader and Acrobat on Windows allow attackers to bypass a sandbox protection mechanism, and consequently execute native code in a privileged context.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Reader and Acrobat Sandbox Bypass Vulnerability

title: Adobe Reader and Acrobat Sandbox Bypass Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Vite Vitejs contains an improper access control vulnerability that exposes content of non-allowed files using ?inline&import or ?raw?import. Only apps explicitly exposing the Vite dev server to the network (using --host or server.host config option) are affected.
